key_concepts: The body has major organs that work together to function properly
The stomach is a muscular organ that squeezes, churns, and twists food
The intestines absorb nutrients and water from digested food
The heart pumps blood throughout the body
The lungs exchange oxygen and carbon dioxide with the blood
The kidneys filter blood and form urine
The brain is the body’s control center
The brain controls voluntary and involuntary body movements
The brain also controls less noticed activities like heartbeat and digestion
The heart and lungs work together to supply oxygen-rich blood to the body
The pulmonary loop moves oxygen-poor blood to the lungs for reoxygenation
The systemic loop moves reoxygenated blood from the heart to the whole body
